$comment: A1-style design document transcribed from the user's hand-run 1976 example (tests: budgets, the doc path, A5 freedom).
design_system_name: 1976 Analog Retro Editorial & Event Landing Page
aesthetic_direction: Mid-to-late 1970s tactile print, warm analog interiors, groovy swash typography, die-cut sticker badges, and balanced geometric ribbon framing.
query_context: A landing page for a 1976-flavoured analog synth and vinyl festival: warm linen paper, swash serif headlines, rainbow ribbons and a sunburst behind a cassette illustration; tactile, joyful and collectible.

wordmark.visual_traits: connected rounded heavy cursive with a cream fill and stacked shadow

display.visual_traits: thick stems, razor-thin hairlines, sweeping swashes

subheading.visual_traits: all-caps, wide tracking, crisp rounded terminals

typography.text_treatment_rules: Display headlines use swashes or a 3D multi-layer drop shadow; UI headings and body stay flat for legibility.

background_layer.base_surface: Soft linen off-white paper with a fine dot-matrix weave

elements.what: Seamless fine dot-matrix / linen paper texture in Soft Linen Off-White
Radial 24-ray retro sunburst in Sun-Baked Cream and Muted Slate rays at 14% opacity with a soft radial fade

what: swash serif title over the sun arch
three framed cards with coloured top accent bars

composition_and_overlap_rules.alignment_grid: 12-column centred container (max-width 1200px) with full-bleed graphic wings outside the central 720px hero column

permitted_overlaps.why: circle vs rectangle, white die-cut edge vs dark bevel
sharp serif strokes against soft concentric arcs

prohibited_overlaps: the ribbons never touch the cassette or the sunburst rays
racing stripes and sunburst rays never share a box
